qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While the Tires division earns healthy ROCE (>20%), the consolidated Automotive and ContiTech divisions suffer from severe OEM buyer power and low profitability. 5-year median group GAAP ROIC/ROCE is ~7-8%, well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Consolidated group returns fail the 12% hurdle (5-year median ROCE ~7-8%) due to the low-margin Automotive supplier division (ROCE near breakeven) facing relentless pricing pressure from automotive OEMs, despite the high-quality Tires division.
qualitative.evidence: Group ROCE was 8.9% in 2021, 3.7% in 2022, 8.9% in 2023, and 11.4% in 2024. Automotive division ROCE languished at -0.6% in 2023 and 2.6% in 2024. Intense OEM buyer power and annual price-down mandates eliminate pricing power at or above inflation for the automotive segment.
